title: RedstoneStick
body: RedstoneStick is a lightweight Minecraft plugin focused on fast redstone building. Use /redstonestick to get a glowing stick that opens a paged item browser packed with redstone parts, rails and minecarts, storage and furnace blocks, pistons/slime/honey, and all wool colors. Click category-style items like fences, gates, buttons, doors, trapdoors, and pressure plates to open variant menus for every wood/type option. It is built to speed up creative redstone workflow without command spam or messy setup.
